Year‐on‐year change in consumer prices, December 2025. Kerala 9.49%, India 1.33%,
Source: MOSPI (CPI, base 2012, combined rural and urban)
Not shown, for want of a comparable figure: Ladakh, Arunachal Pradesh, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and
Each dot is a state or union territory, placed by how fast its prices rose in the year to
December 2025. The line is India as a whole; the further a dot sits from it, the more that place differs.
